title: Kazakh Lesser Zhuz Oath to Russia
summary: Abulkhair, khan of the Kazakh Junior Zhuz (Little Horde), sought Russian help against the Dzungars. An imperial charter dated 19 February 1731 accepted the request, and on 10 October 1731 the Russian envoy Tevkelev took the oath of the Junior Zhuz Kazakhs. Qalam says the oath's meaning was unclear; the Middle Zhuz swore a similar oath in 1732.

uncertainty.note: Oath date 10 October 1731 per e-history.kz; Qalam gives only October 1731. Charter dated 19 February 1731. Calendar (Julian/Gregorian) not stated by the sources.

where.modern_name: Yrgyz village, Aktobe Region, Kazakhstan (regional proxy pin in the western Kazakh steppe; oath site not given by the opened sources)
where.historical_name: Junior Zhuz (Little Horde) steppe, Kazakh Khanate

importance.justification: Start of formal ties between a Kazakh zhuz and the Russian Empire, later extended to the other zhuzes.
